verdict: It's a draw. Calories, protein and fat are almost the same. The difference is how much rice and gravy you take.
why: Both are about 750 kcal a plate.
Protein is almost the same: about 32 g for nasi kandar, 33 g for chicken briyani.
Fat is also close: about 31 g for nasi kandar, 29 g for briyani.
Both are easy to overdo: nasi kandar with rice drowned in gravy, briyani with rice already cooked in santan or oil, and big portions.
when_a: Nasi kandar is okay when you can control the gravy and add vegetables like okra or cabbage.
when_b: Chicken briyani is okay for a function or special day, eaten with cucumber acar and dalca.
tip: Ask for less rice, take one protein dish, add vegetables, and just a little gravy. This works better than choosing between the two dishes.

faq.q: Does kuah campur (mixed gravy) have a lot of calories?
faq.a: Kuah campur has oil and santan, so calories can go up a lot. Ask for a little gravy or have it on the side.

faq.q: Can I eat nasi kandar while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes. Make it your main meal of the day, take less rice, and make sure your other meals are lighter.
